caseName: United States v. National Steel Corp.
caseNameFull: United States v. National Steel Corp.
attorneys: Solicitor General Marshall for the United States, and Denman,Moody and C. Brien Dillon for National Steel Corp. et al., and B. J. Bradshaw for Brown et al., on the motion.

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. S. D. Tex. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 383 U. S. 905.) Joint motion to refer this case to the United States District Court for the Southern District of Texas granted and case referred to that court for consideration of the .settlement agreement.
